title: Peculiar and Usefull Treasures
description: A mod that adds new rewards for Minecraft Vanilla Structures.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6aac7951a0022d80a994860413e22963c9873ec.png)

### Description:
Wouldn't you like it if Minecraft's Dungeon Loot were better and more rewarding? Well, if that's the case, then Peculiar and Useful Treasures is for you. This Mod basically makes it so that every time you open up a Structure-generated chest, you have the possibility of finding 30 new, distinct treasures, which range from items like "_The Bone Stone_", which grants you an great amount of bone meal everytime you craft it with a bone; armor pieces like "_The Cape of Steel_" which makes you jump very high, while wearing it; Weapons like "_The Homerunner_", which make send flying far away every enemy it strikes and finally blocks like "_The Pot of the Leprificate_" which is a pot of emeralds that every certain amount of time, spawns an emerald.
These and many more treasures are there to be found, which will make the entire dungeon exploration part of Minecraft much more exciting, as many of these treasures will be useful, powerful, and some others will be simply of a very peculiar design.

If any of these treasures caught your attention, then how about you enter the wiki to see the list of 30 different treasures and which exact chest they spawn at? 

And if it convinced you, I hope you truly enjoy downloading it for your fresh new world.
